notes: Layered necropolis rebuild base for the opening Egypt Journey scene. The active art direction is warm semi-realistic Valley of the Kings cliffs crossed with Memphite Necropolis ruins, with only subtle corruption marks. The background is now split into sky/light, far pyramids, distant cliffs, and mid necropolis ruins before the gameplay floor is drawn. The playable stone path is a dedicated world-locked route layer so Asha runs on the same visible route used by collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates. The ground backing layer is non-colliding visual support so the walkable floor reads as continuous land instead of a floating ledge.
groundLaneNote: Dedicated necropolis stone path layer. Drawn at parallax 1.0 (locked to the world / collision floor) so Asha runs on the same visible route that collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates use.
coordinateNote: The active runtime uses layered PNGs. skyLight carries the warm sunset and base haze; farPyramids, distantCliffs, and midNecropolisRuins each draw at a different camera speed so the Egypt background has real depth instead of a single flat plate. groundBacking sits directly behind and under the gameplay floor as a visual-only sand body; groundLane scrolls at gameplay speed and remains the visible source of truth for the walkable floor. The final rebuild should replace these temporary split-from-source depth layers with a high quality Valley of the Kings plus Memphite Necropolis set that preserves the ravine bridge and pyramid climb route.
